text:
oncall-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts detected for /v1/generate across prod edge (region-us). 5xx spike started ~09:01 UTC. Paging oncall (rotation: @morgan).

morgan: I see the alert, I'm taking it. Starting triage — checking batch scheduler queues and gateway traces.

morgan: quick metrics glance: 5xx rate 18% on edge -> scheduler, median scheduler head latency 3200ms, some shards show queue_length > 300. Head-of-line blocking suspected.

anya: @morgan noted. Which pool/shard? can you post the problematic hosts?

morgan: batch-queue-7 and batch-queue-11 are the worst. Nodes n-sched-07,n-sched-11 show memory pressure + long KV cache write stalls. logs snippet: ```[2026-03-15T09:02:13Z] node=n-sched-07 ERROR dispatch.go:134 timeout scheduling batch: enqueue wait > 5s | gateway->scheduler 502```.

kai: adding playbook link: <https://playbooks/redwood/batching-headline-eviction|batching-hol-playbook>. Steps recommended: 1) evict oldest KV cache entries 2) scale scheduler workers 3) enable emergency ingress throttling rule 4) reroute traffic away from hot nodes.

morgan: executing step 2 & 4 now. kubectl scale deploy/batch-scheduler -n prod --replicas=22  # from 12

morgan: rerouting node n-sched-07 out of rotation: `curl -X POST "https://controlplane/api/v1/nodes/n-sched-07/drain" -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'`

anya: I'll trigger eviction on the KV cache. API to use: `POST /internal/admin/kvcache/evict?limit=50`. Running:
```
curl -s -X POST "https://admin-api/internal/kvcache/evict?limit=50" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```
Gave a 200 with "evicted=48"

srebot: NOTE: autoscaler kicked in for batch-scheduler (scaled from 12 -> 22) at 09:03:08 UTC.

morgan: After scale + eviction, observing 5xx drop to ~7% and queue_length on batch-queue-7 fell to ~120. Head latency down to ~900ms.

devex_julian: Good progress. Can we enable the routing fallback to smaller model for problematic routes to buy more headroom? That reduces per-request tokens.

morgan: Yes. Flipping fallback-route for /v1/generate to model:redwood-lite-1 temporarily. Doing via console API:
```
POST https://console/api/v1/routes/route-325/fallback
{"model":"redwood-lite-1","duration":"15m","reason":"emergency-runaway-queue"}
```

morgan: fallback applied. Observed additional reduction in request processing time. 5xx now ~3.2% at 09:06 UTC.

cs-aly: CS update: LumenFlow reported intermittent 502s and timeouts earlier. I let them know we're mitigating and will follow up after stabilization. Keeping them in 'partial degraded' state.

kai: I'm starting an incident doc: https://incidents/redwood/1785002468-runtime-pileup. Add root cause hypotheses and timeline. Assigning owner for follow-up: @kai.

anya: note — one host still shows anomalous KV stall traces; reimage scheduled if it doesn't stabilize. @morgan can you leave it drained?

morgan: leaving n-sched-07 drained. I'll monitor for 30m and then decide reimage vs reinstate.

oncall-bot: RESOLVED: 5xx rate reduced to <1% sustained for 5m; automated alert suppressed. Incident state -> mitigated.

morgan: marking immediate mitigation complete. Next actions: 1) run deeper memory + KV cache investigation on n-sched-07 2) confirm autoscaler config didn't overshoot cost threshold 3) post-incident timeline + customer impact summary.

kai: Postmortem owner confirmed. @cs-aly will prepare customer-facing note. @devex_julian please add notes for dashboard runbook improvements (alert thresholds + automatic fallback enable).

cs-aly: I'll draft the customer note and circulate for review. LumenFlow will get a direct update in 30 mins.

morgan: handing off monitoring to @anya for the next 45m. I'm on standby if it re-escalates. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

anya: ack. I'll keep this thread updated with any regressions.

srebot: INCIDENT CHECKLIST: mitigation applied, scaling evicted, fallback enabled, customer notified, postmortem owner assigned.

kai: closing thread for live mitigation. We'll leave this as an active incident record until postmortem is posted.
